CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   B. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.

   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

15. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
